mechanism.summary: For an exact same-function direct-leaf call in syntactic tail position, reset the active frame in place with the new direct-call slots instead of constructing a child CallEnv, Vm, and FrameState.
mechanism.generality: Selection depends only on the existing direct-leaf contract, exact Function identity, immutable bytecode tail position, empty active abrupt-completion state, and whether the bytecode can reuse its slot-backed receiver contract. It contains no benchmark name, source path, input, iteration-count, checksum, or expected-result condition. Every non-tail, different-function, dynamic-scope, closure, this-sensitive, try/finally-active, or otherwise unsupported call continues through the unchanged direct-leaf path before observable callee work.
semantic_risks: preserving exact Function identity so two distinct functions that share bytecode never share a frame
resetting parameter, hoisted-local, operand, virtual-value, loop-decline, and pending-completion state exactly as a fresh direct-leaf frame would
retaining receiver evaluation and ordinary call argument order before the frame-reuse decision
declining whenever a catch, finally, disposal scope, generator state, or pending abrupt completion could observe a distinct child frame
retaining direct-leaf fallback for any body that needs a freshly normalized this binding or other per-call compatibility state

profile_evidence.source: macOS sample 2026-07-29 /tmp/qjs-current-profile-clean.u7Te8d/controlflow.sample; freshly built current-main runtime (source-identical to af4a65a1). The official controlflow-recursive source ran directly; sampling was diagnostic only. The profile records 585 top stacks in call_direct_leaf_function and 570 in Vm::new_with_globals_upvalues_with_stack_and_direct_call_slots beneath the recursive execution chain. A separate output-only count of the official workload observed 55,177 ack, 114,625 fib, and 75,687 tak invocations; ack and tak contain syntactic self-tail edges while fib remains a non-tail control.
profile_evidence.shared_cost: The current recursive tail edge still creates a complete direct-leaf child and only then reaches the generic VM executor. Reusing the current slot-backed frame at that edge removes the child environment and frame construction rather than merely changing the prior tail-call probe or scheduler transfer.
